digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend port / jira adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (applier, fetcher, apply_handlers, _attestation) directly import adapters.jira for scalar concerns (project scoping, env validation, exception handling), violating the vendor-neutral port contract.

The Backend protocol must expose scalar, translation-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) and neutral exceptions (BackendEnvError, BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) to decouple core logic from Jira-specific imports.
Nested lazy imports within function bodies are not caught by the existing top-level-only AST analysis; a full-tree walk is required to guarantee removal of all adapters.jira references.
JiraBackend must implement the new protocol members by delegating to resolve_jira_settings with appropriate defaults and attestation checks, preserving existing fail-fast and fail-closed semantics.
The S2 contract suite, FakeBackend, and ADR 0035 documentation must be updated to reflect the widened Backend protocol interface.
